entry_points.text: Cache population validates leaves, enumerates entries, assigns IDs, initializes descriptors and builds sharing maps.
Per-CPU init with boot restore and AP rendezvous completes delayed setup and tracks online CPUs.
Vendor dispatch picks alternate interface for legacy families; no-optimizer builds expose inert cleanup reporting no change.

exports.text: Boot split and bus lock setup runs detection then state init then reporting.
Cache discovery offers vendor LLC IDs, Intel and Hygon detection, leaf validation and per-CPU population with sharing maps.
MTRR control offers paired disable and enable plus guarded state sync.
Deferred AP cache init uses a flag with set and query ops to select early versus rendezvous setup.
Diagnostics map types to labels, gate debug output, and report slot use, candidates and scaled sizes.
Platform layer reports trusted boot and tunes virtualization and enclave caps from feature control.

hazards.text: Flush skipped with self snoop, TLB flushes counted, offline and register failures only warn or log, DRAM modify warns and clears.
Empty and invalid encodings, zero leaves, missing descriptors, offline peers and absent L3 yield fallback except validation and population propagate.
Low-memory uncached overlap warns as firmware bug with adjusted subtraction; gaining candidates invalid; overflow warns and truncates to fixed prefix.
Cache types use small codes with per-index levels, types and stepped associativity decoding; enumeration uses Intel and AMD extended leaves.
Crypto and random presence, enable and activation bits, virtualization index masking, seven-entry attribute table and five-level early tables are fixed.

invariants.text: Split lock needs hypervisor absence plus model match or core caps with arch bit; reporting branches on off, rate, fatal and warn with conditional offline install.
Leaf fill splits AMD and Hygon versus Intel, AMD preferring extended leaf else legacy from historic leaves; null type rejected, else stored with size from incremented geometry.
Cache IDs shift APIC by sharing width with masked-base variant; AMD skips without L3 and picks die, shifted APIC or sharing form by family, Hygon always shifted APIC.
Hygon records leaf count; Intel prefers deterministic else historic descriptors, accumulates sizes, records L2 and L3 IDs and backfills LLC preferring larger higher sizes.
Sharing delegates AMD and Hygon first, marks self, exits if private, else links online peers with matching shifted APIC; descriptors copy ID, translate type and store geometry.
Per-CPU init runs disable, sync and enable only with MTRR flag and PAT init only with its flag; rendezvous runs setup when deferred active or CPU appears offline.
MTRR is enabled exactly when a control interface is chosen; legacy families switch when emulation is advertised and table init marks each slot singly used.
Variable sync writes only on masked difference; fixed sync checks DRAM guard and writes differing halves; disable saves default then writes disabled uncached, enable restores.
Ordered map ignores empty intervals, coalesces adjacent non-fixed equal types, pins writeback above 4G with extension, appends enabled ranges and resolves conflicts to effective type.
Cleanup needs active subsystem, CPU cap, admin allowance and uncached default; coverage keeps low 1M cached, merges cached and subtracts uncached and protected with fixup.
Layout converts extents to power-of-two slots with hole-aware granularity growth, coalesces adjacent extents, zeroes trailing slots and picks smallest zero-loss candidate within spare bounds.
Feature control withdraws caps when unreadable or left disabled after gated locked install; VMX merges controls into flags and special default needs vendor, family and syscfg bits.
Further boot capability, CPU data, CPUID, control register, TLB, mask iteration, logging, accounting, platform and descriptor helpers used here live outside this dossier.

locks.text: Global cache-disable lock serializes no-fill, flushes, control updates and range changes; disable acquires and enable releases across the window.
AP online path must not take the memory type mutex in boot or resume; safety uses absent updates and hotplug lock held by updaters.

state_machines.text: Cache moves normal to locked no-fill flushed and back; memory type sync compares current with desired, rewrites selectively and publishes change mask.
Boot derives reservation from address width, chooses interface, discovers counts, prepares tables, validates, then optimizes and maps or ends read-only or disabled.
Candidates rebuild state per chunk and granularity, record usage and loss, discard coverage gain, and select smallest zero-loss index within bounds.
Feature control goes probe to locked decision to virtualization then enclave validation, each stage pruning its capability independently.

structs.text: Deterministic EAX carries type, level and sharing, EBX line, partition and ways, ECX sets, with identifier and size in the aggregate.
Per-CPU sharing masks and global cacheinfo mask track groups; saved control value preserves paging across quiesce.
Per-CPU x86 description with user limit and topology maxima is immutable after init; Centaur driver binds vendor IDs with early and normal hooks.
